bibliographic.title: Deep Patient: An Unsupervised Representation to Predict the Future of Patients from the Electronic Health Records

dataset.source_name: Mount Sinai Health System data warehouse

model.selection_criterion: three-layer stacked denoising autoencoders + random forest classifier
model.feature_selection_method: >40,000 medical descriptors compressed to 500 deep representation features
model.preprocessing_pipeline: Autoencoder trained on full cohort including test patients' historical data

leakage_risk_assessment.notes: REPRESENTATION LEAKAGE — autoencoder (unsupervised feature extractor) trained on full cohort including test patients' historical records. This means the learned representation encodes information from test patients. Temporal split for labels but not for representation learning. No calibration. No CI. Broad claims across 78 diseases with varying quality. Uninterpretable features. No external validation.

reviewer_notes.notes: METHODOLOGICAL ISSUES. Representation leakage — autoencoder fit on full data including test patients. No CI, no calibration, no external validation. MLGG should flag leakage_gate (preprocessing on full data), calibration_dca_gate, ci_matrix_gate.
